Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our end and next steps below so we have a shared record. I dropped the recording and the deck (attached) in case you want to share internally.

Key takeaways from the call:
- Primary use case: reduce physician charting time by surfacing structured summaries during note drafting (ED + outpatient piloting).
- Current constraints: mixed EHRs across pilot sites, strict PHI routing requirements, and a 6–9 month procurement window for pilot approvals.
- Success criteria: 30% reduction in documentation time on a small cohort; no PHI leaves VPC during pilot.

What we (Redwood) will do:
- Share recording + slide deck (attached).
- Pull a short security checklist focused on data-in-transit and KMS options (SOC2 scope).

Suggested next steps:
1) Quick 20-minute Q&A / technical sync with your clinical informatics lead — I can do Tues/Thurs next week (9–11am PT) or Wed 2–4pm PT.
2) If you prefer, book directly: https://calendly.com/lauren-redwood/20min
3) I’ll follow up with an initial list of integration touchpoints and a short checklist for pilot readiness.

Attachments: BP-demo-deck-v1.pdf
Recording link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-BluePeakDemo

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.
